name: DCA Flo's V8 Cafe "Ka-Cheeseburger" Plain Angus Burger on Sesame Bun
whyItWorks: Angus beef patty with melted cheddar cheese on a soft sesame bun with fries. When ordered plain without Thousand Island sauce, pickles, or raw onions, it is very easy on digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Ka-Cheeseburger plain with ketchup only (hold Thousand Island dressing, raw onions, and pickles).
watchOuts: Hold raw onions, pickles, and Thousand Island sauce
